issues.explanation: This is an ordinary verb-complement phrase meaning to wash away or sift away completely, not a lexicalized idiom.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark as a regular word or compositional verb-complement, with a local gloss such as “wash away completely.”

issues.explanation: In “古今多少事,” this means “how many” or “so many,” not simply “number.”
Here 江渚上 means “on the river islet”; the gloss is an unrelated dictionary entry.
In “都付笑谈中,” 笑谈 means light or casual talk, not an object of ridicule.
Here “桓、灵帝时” means “during the reigns of Emperors Huan and Ling,” not the surname Shi.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “during the time of; when.”

issues.explanation: In 青蛇, 青 means green or blue-green; it does not refer to Qinghai.
This is the ordinary noun “snake,” not a variant-entry explanation.
化 means “to transform into” in 鸡化雄; the current gloss treats it as a variant of 花 and obscures the event.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss 化 as “to transform into; become.”

issues.explanation: In 干政, 干 means to interfere in or meddle with politics, not simply to manage.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to interfere in; meddle with.”

issues.explanation: In 朝政日坏, 日 means “increasingly” or “day by day,” not Japan.
This incorrectly combines the noun 人 with the personal name 张角, hiding the natural segmentation of “a native of Julu, Zhang Jue.”
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 人 and 张角; keep 张角 together as the personal name.

issues.explanation: In 南华老仙, 南华 is part of the immortal’s epithet/name, not “South China.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss in context as “Nanhua” and consider grouping the epithet 南华老仙 together.

issues.explanation: Here 天书 means heavenly or divine books/scriptures, not an imperial edict.
符水 is a lexicalized term for talisman water used in ritual healing; splitting 水 as a surname is materially misleading.
issues.suggested_fix: Group as 符水 and gloss as “talisman water.”

issues.explanation: This is Zhang Jue’s self-styled title, not the ordinary sequence “big / virtuous / teacher.”
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 大贤良师 together and gloss as “Great Teacher of Virtue” or “Great Worthy Teacher.”

issues.explanation: In 带金帛联络封谞, 带 means “to bring or carry,” not “band.”
起兵 is a common lexical verb meaning to raise troops or launch an uprising; splitting it into “rise” and “soldiers” obscures the action.
issues.suggested_fix: Group as 起兵 and gloss as “to raise troops; launch an uprising.”

issues.explanation: In 天公将军, 将军 is the title “general,” not a place-name entry.
In 地公将军, 将军 is the title “general,” not a place-name entry.
In 人公将军, 将军 is the title “general,” not a place-name entry.
Here 万 is the number unit “ten thousand,” not the unrelated entry 万俟.
In 朝廷派卢植等人, 派 means “to send or dispatch,” not the unrelated 派司 entry.
In 刘焉在幽州, 在 marks location and means “in; at,” not “to exist.”
